description:
Claim a crown for a specific token on a specific chain. Requires verified ownership. Returns an order action spec for inclusion in create_order.

Params: symbol (string), chain (string), token_address (string), verification_method ('deployer'|'mint_authority'|'owner'|'majority_holder'), session_token (string)
Returns: {order_action_spec: {type: 'claim_crown', params: {symbol, chain, token_address, verification_method, wallet}}}
Errors: NO_SESSION, SESSION_EXPIRED, INVALID_CHAIN, INVALID_VERIFICATION_METHOD

symbol.description: Token symbol to claim crown for (e.g., 'PEPE')

token_address.description: Token contract/mint address on the specified chain

verification_method.description: Method used to verify ownership: 'deployer', 'mint_authority', 'owner', or 'majority_holder'

name: claim_crown
title: Build a registration claim action
